_comment: Amazon Lex Bot Configuration — defines what the AI chatbot understands
description: AI chatbot for handling common customer queries before routing to an agent

intents.name: CheckAccountStatus
intents._comment: Customer says: 'What is my account status?' or 'Check my account'

slots.name: AccountNumber
slots.prompt: Sure! Could you please share your account number?

fulfillmentActivity._comment: This calls a Lambda function to actually fetch the account info

intents.name: RaiseComplaint
intents._comment: Customer says: 'I want to raise a complaint' or 'I have a problem'
sampleUtterances: I want to raise a complaint

slots.name: ComplaintType
slots.prompt: What type of issue are you facing? Billing, Technical, or Other?

fulfillmentActivity._comment: Returns to Amazon Connect contact flow to route to a specialist queue

intents.name: TransferToAgent
intents._comment: Customer asks to speak to a human agent
sampleUtterances: I want to talk to someone

intents.name: FallbackIntent
intents._comment: Triggered when the bot doesn't understand the customer

fulfillmentActivity.response: I'm sorry, I didn't understand that. Let me connect you to an agent.
